rows.text: A hash map uses collision resolution techniques like chaining or open addressing to handle collisions. Chaining stores multiple entries in a linked list at the same index. Open addressing finds another open slot nearby. Both ensure efficient data retrieval even with hash collisions.

rows.text: A robot named R2 learned to paint. It mixed colors, made marks, and created art. R2 found joy in the process, not just the result. It discovered creativity, proving that even machines can learn to express themselves through paint.

rows.text: TCP is connection oriented and guarantees delivery while UDP is connectionless and does not guarantee delivery. TCP is more reliable but slower than UDP.

rows.text: Supervised learning uses labeled data to train models, while unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabeled data. Supervised learning predicts outcomes, and unsupervised learning groups or clusters data.
